Permissions required by samples/tenant-policies.entra.json (mode: delegated, 6 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph delegated permissions
  Application.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/servicePrincipals/ref(/providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal).appId
      (edge: claimsMappingPolicies; edge: tokenLifetimePolicies; provider)
  Directory.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groupLifecyclePolicies/default
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-sales-emea
      (edge: groupLifecyclePolicies; provider)
  Group.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-sales-emea
      (provider)
  Policy.Read.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/policies/claimsMappingPolicies/Portal employee id claim
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/policies/tokenLifetimePolicies/Portal access tokens (2h)
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/servicePrincipals/ref(/providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal).appId
      (edge: claimsMappingPolicies; edge: tokenLifetimePolicies; provider)
  Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguration
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/policies/claimsMappingPolicies/Portal employee id claim
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/policies/tokenLifetimePolicies/Portal access tokens (2h)
      (provider)

Entra roles (the signed-in user needs at least one role of each group)
  Application Administrator | Application Developer | Cloud Application Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal
      (provider)
  Application Administrator | Cloud Application Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/policies/claimsMappingPolicies/Portal employee id claim
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/policies/tokenLifetimePolicies/Portal access tokens (2h)
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/servicePrincipals/ref(/providers/Microsoft.Entra/applications/contoso-portal).appId
      (edge: claimsMappingPolicies; edge: tokenLifetimePolicies; provider)
  Groups Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-sales-emea
      (provider)
  Groups Administrator | User Administrator
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groupLifecyclePolicies/default
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/team-sales-emea
      (edge: groupLifecyclePolicies; provider)

note: Delegated scopes must be present on the token that earm auth login obtains (the app registration of --client-id needs them as delegated permissions); the signed-in user must additionally hold at least one role of every 'Entra roles' group (the roles are alternatives).
note: 1 resource(s) have a name that depends on another resource (for example a service principal named after reference(...).appId); their permissions are computed from the declaration and the references it contains.
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
